headline: Congress approved appointing Roger W. Ferguson as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian Institution's Board of Regents.
what_it_does: This joint resolution names Roger W. Ferguson as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Board of Regents oversees the Smithsonian, a group of museums, research centers, and the National Zoo. The resolution is a single appointment and does not change any other law.
when_it_takes_effect: The resolution was enacted on April 19, 2017.
